nodes.label: Overview
nodes.description: A high-level introduction to what the product or system is, its features, purpose, and intended audience.

nodes.label: Installation and getting started
nodes.description: Instructions for installing, setting up, or first running the product, including requirements and quick-start steps.

nodes.label: Configuration
nodes.description: Explanation of settings, options, parameters, and environment needed to tailor the product's behavior.

nodes.label: Usage
nodes.description: Task-oriented instructions and examples showing how to operate the product in normal use.

nodes.label: Reference
nodes.description: Lookup material such as API, command, register, message, or function descriptions, organized for consultation rather than reading in order.

nodes.label: Specifications
nodes.description: Quantitative technical data such as electrical characteristics, ratings, dimensions, timing, and performance limits, typically in tables.

nodes.label: Troubleshooting
nodes.description: Guidance on diagnosing problems, including error messages, symptoms, causes, fixes, and frequently asked questions.

nodes.label: Appendix
nodes.description: Supplementary material placed after the main body, such as glossaries, revision history, ordering information, legal notices, and extra tables, as opposed to the lookup material in reference.
